[EN] So long as that shield is in place, we can't launch a coordinated assault on the fortress.

The shield must be brought down, and without destroying it. How we'll manage that miracle, I've no idea.
[ES] Mientras ese escudo esté activo, no podemos lanzar un asalto coordinado a la fortaleza.

Hay que desactivar el escudo, y sin destruirlo. No tengo idea de cómo lograremos that milagro.
